question: Detection probability for DAF compliance errors: from the IRS Data Book (2021+ tables on examinations of tax-exempt returns and excise-tax returns Form 4720) and TIGE annual reports, estimate the share of DAF sponsors examined per year and the count of §4966/§4967 assessments, to replace the swept P(detected and taxed) of 0.01-1
conclusion_affected: Routing variant m; whether routing beats assistance in P07/P08
rationale: Expected m scales one-for-one with this probability; it is the single largest unsourced factor in the composite m (central 2.4 at p = 0.1; 106 at p = 1)

question: OCC and Federal Reserve BSA/AML orders 2021+: retrieve the OCC order PDFs (eaAA-ENF-2026-41, eaAA-ENF-2024-77/78) through a robots-allowed route and check whether any states a count of late or missed SARs that the FinCEN orders do not
conclusion_affected: Bank cost-per-missed-SAR range (n = 4 core depository orders)
rationale: The OCC static PDF URL returned an HTML page, not the order; OCC news releases (TD 2024, BofA 2026) and the Fed TD order state no counts

question: Lookback and remediation cost of a missed SAR: find a 2021+ primary statement (bank annual report or regulator order) giving the dollar cost or duration of a SAR lookback, to replace the swept 0.5-2 year duration of Bank of America's 800-consultant lookback
conclusion_affected: Bank-side m beyond the penalty (lookback adds 374-1,496 P14 handling units per missed SAR at 0.5-2 years)
rationale: The BofA order states 800 consultants but not duration or cost; sec.gov is not usable under the shared rules, so bank annual reports must come from the banks' own sites

question: OFAC 2021+ enforcement releases against charities, payment processors or donor platforms: collect penalty and stated count of violating transactions, as the nearest regime analogue for P01/P14 (sanctions screening) at a DAF sponsor
rationale: DAF sponsors are not BSA SAR filers, so bank SAR penalties carry over only by analogy; OFAC strict-liability penalties apply to charities directly and usually state transaction counts

question: Grant clawback and reversal frequency at DAF sponsors: from sponsor program policies and 990 Schedule I/D notes (2021+), document how often sponsors recover or reverse a grant made in error and the staff effort involved
conclusion_affected: Operational m (swept 1-5) and the correction unit for compliance errors
rationale: The operational-error m carries about 51% of the AI-amenable pool weight (processes outside P01/P07/P08/P14) and has no source
